principle: Launch publicly for discovery and validation while keeping commerce, unfinished art, and founder controls gated until their specific readiness checks pass.

points.title: Complete NestRune name clearance
points.why: NestRune was selected after CardNest showed direct trading-card conflicts. A preliminary screen found no obvious exact-match TCG/game conflict, but professional clearance is still required before major trademark spending or commercial launch.
points.next: Founder obtains a qualified U.S. trademark clearance review for NESTRUNE, NEST RUNE, phonetic variants, similar NEST-formative marks, and the planned software/game/card services.

points.title: Public beta, not finished commerce
points.why: The site can be public for discovery while real purchases remain disabled.
points.next: Keep real payments disabled until legal, support, economics, art, and security gates are approved.

points.title: Perfect the visible cards
points.why: Known legacy Theme/class badge and palette issues can damage trust immediately.
points.next: Show only clearly labeled review assets and remaster flagged cards before calling them final.

points.title: Explain the product in five seconds
points.why: Visitors must quickly understand original guardians, collecting, pack previews, My Nest, and future play.
points.next: Measure whether visitors reach Season One and card close-up views.

points.title: Security and founder controls
points.why: Private tools, production changes, generation, and commerce must remain server-authorized and auditable.
points.next: Continue abuse, authz, cross-user, secret, backup, and incident-response testing.

points.title: Customer trust and support
points.why: Public commerce needs a real support path, clear seller identity, delivery/refund rules, privacy process, and transparent pack terms.
points.next: Use the NestRune support form consistently and finalize the customer-request, retention, seller-identity, delivery, and refund workflow before commercial sales.

points.title: Measure the collector funnel
points.why: Traffic is useful only if NestRune learns which pages, Themes, cards, and intentional interest clicks create return visits.
points.next: Use privacy-conscious first-party measurements; avoid invasive behavioral advertising.

points.title: Prove unit economics before Stripe
points.why: Pricing must include payment fees, art/model costs, hosting, support, refunds, acquisition, and repeat behavior.
points.next: Validate real cost inputs in Pricing & margins and approve a viable scenario.

points.title: Keep third-party discovery separate
points.why: Pokémon and Magic can support discovery/affiliate revenue without confusing them with original NestRune IP.
points.next: Complete TCGplayer/Impact and eBay Partner Network acceptance, then add only the exact network-generated HTTPS links through protected environment variables.

points.title: Validate with 50–100 real collectors
points.why: Real collector behavior should shape the next art, pack, and gameplay investments.
points.next: Soft-launch, gather opt-in feedback, measure return behavior, and prioritize what collectors actually use.

brandClearance.rule: Treat NestRune as the working replacement brand, not as legally cleared, until a qualified trademark professional completes a comprehensive review covering federal records, common-law use, state records, domains, app stores, software/game marks, card-related goods, and relevant international markets.
brandClearance.knownRisk: The preliminary screen found no obvious exact-match NestRune TCG/game conflict and the nestrune.com domain was available when checked, but similarity risks can still arise from NEST-formative and software/entertainment marks.
ethics: Do not use the registered trademark symbol unless a registration actually issues for the relevant mark.
Keep third-party franchises and affiliate products clearly separated from original NestRune IP.
Do not copy logos, trade dress, product descriptions, mascots, or branding from third parties.
Preserve evidence of first use, design creation, original artwork provenance, and the CardNest-to-NestRune transition.

rules: No affiliate link becomes active until the relevant network approves NestRune.
Use exact network-generated links; do not invent tracking parameters.
Disclose commissions clearly and conspicuously next to the shopping area.
Do not use unlicensed product images.
Do not imply that NestRune authenticates, fulfills, or guarantees third-party listings.
Store aggregate NestRune click events only; do not create behavioral ad profiles.
Update pending affiliate applications and verified media properties from the former CardNest URL/name to NestRune before activating links.
